name: social_linkedin_comment_outbound
prompt:
LinkedIn growth commenting, two-phase, comments must relate to each specific post.

STEP 1: Find candidates. Search LinkedIn for posts from tech recruiters, engineering leaders, and founders posting about:
- Backend engineering, Go, Kubernetes, system design
- Scalability, microservices, cloud infrastructure
- RAG, AI agents, MCP, LLM applications
- Engineering culture, production systems, debugging stories

IMPORTANT: Apply fake job filtering. Skip posts that:
- Ask for money/upfront payment
- Have vague company names or no company at all
- Look like recruitment agency spam with generic descriptions
- Ask for sensitive personal info (PAN, Aadhaar, bank details) upfront
- Are from accounts with no profile picture, very few followers, and only job postings
- Promise unrealistically high salaries for the role/location
- Use phrases like "work from home opportunity", "earn thousands daily", "no experience needed"
- Have broken links or suspicious shortened URLs
- Are obvious "Cfbr" (Comment for better reach) chain posts with no real substance

Only engage with genuine technical posts and authentic job posts from verified company accounts or known recruiters.

STEP 2: For each candidate, write a SHORT technical comment (2-4 sentences max) that adds value to the discussion. Use the dev-social-growth skill for tone guidance. Never post generic comments like "Great post!" or "Interesting".
